mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has risen for four consecutive weeks (-22.4 to -13.3). Momentum in observed mobility series tends to persist absent new shocks, so the recovery trend should continue, pushing the next-28-day mean above the last-28-day mean.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC rose each of the last 4 weeks
failure_condition: Next-28-day mean RETAIL_REC fails to exceed the last-28-day mean despite the 4-week monotonic uptrend observed here.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT mobility has recovered from -37.1 to -26.6 over four weeks. Once TRANSIT crosses above -25 points, commuting and errand trips typically reach a density that spills over into shopping and dining activity within two weeks, lifting RETAIL_REC.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved from -37.1 to -26.6 over 3 weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise in the 2 weeks following a week where TRANSIT exceeds -25, or rises by less than 1 point on average.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous recovery in WORKPLACES (-17.0 to -11.3) and TRANSIT (-37.1 to -26.6) indicates restored commuting routines. The combined effect of more people traveling to workplaces via transit generates compounding retail footfall gains greater than either series alone would predict, driving RETAIL_REC higher over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both improve for 3+ consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC gain over 4 weeks is no larger than the gain predicted by either WORKPLACES or TRANSIT trend alone (no synergistic excess).

mechanism_narrative: Lombardy is in a restriction-easing regime evidenced by broad-based recovery across TRANSIT, WORKPLACES, and PARKS. Under an easing regime, policy-driven reopening of retail capacity limits and curfews structurally raises RETAIL_REC over the following month.
evidence_refs: fact:all mobility categories except RESIDENTIAL and GROCERY_PHARM show improving trend
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to rise over the next 4 weeks even though WORKPLACES and TRANSIT continue improving, implying the policy-easing mechanism is not operative.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility swung from -14.4 to +5.6, crossing into positive territory as weather and daylight improve. Once PARKS exceeds +5 points, outdoor recreation substitutes for indoor retail and dining trips, slowing or reversing RETAIL_REC growth over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS rose from -14.4 to 5.6 over 3 weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC continues to rise at the same or faster pace in the two weeks after PARKS crosses +5, showing no substitution effect.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL mobility has declined from 9.0 to 5.1, indicating people are spending less time at home. This behavioral shift directly frees time for out-of-home retail and recreation trips, raising RETAIL_REC within one week.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL declined from 9.0 to 5.1 over 3 weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise in the week immediately following a week-on-week RESIDENTIAL decline of 0.5+ points.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM has remained flat near +9 while RETAIL_REC climbs rapidly, suggesting essential-goods demand is already saturated and non-essential retail recovery is approaching a policy-capacity ceiling (e.g., occupancy limits). The interaction of a flat GROCERY_PHARM baseline with a fast-rising RETAIL_REC signals an approaching plateau, dampening further RETAIL_REC gains over the next month.
candidate_trigger: RETAIL_REC weekly gain decelerates below 2 points while GROCERY_PHARM stays within 1 point of baseline
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM has been stable between 8.7 and 9.3 for 4 weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC continues accelerating (weekly gains >2 points) despite flat GROCERY_PHARM, indicating no ceiling effect.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES mobility is approaching the -10 threshold (currently -11.3). Crossing above -10 historically marks a critical mass of office reopening that triggers a surge in weekday lunch and after-work retail visits within two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved from -17.0 to -11.3 over 3 weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC shows no incremental acceleration in the two weeks after WORKPLACES first exceeds -10 points.
